chapter: New Orleans bands: Cheek, Parker, Morgan
title: On the road with Morgan in Mississippi
summary: Weekend trips to Hattiesburg, Laurel and Morse Point, travel by rented cars, and halls and hotels played.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: But where did you go with Isaiah Morgan? We never did get in that.

You went out on the road, huh? Yeah, in Hattiesburg, Mississippi, Buckalooza, Columbus, Mississippi. He traveled all the time or he played in the Orleans? Isaiah never did play in the Orleans. Oh yeah? Oh every weekend we got on the road.
Mm-hmm. We went all those towns and, he was known in Mississippi. Yeah.
Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He was known in Mississippi. Yeah. All on the highway, people, everybody, white and colored. How did he travel? In cars? Yeah, the car, yeah. The whole band in one car? Yeah, a couple cars. He didn't have one, he'd rent one. Oh yeah, did he have the whole band in one car? Well he didn't have all five pieces. Oh I see. Yeah. Yeah. And most times they tied the bass on top of the drum on top of the car. Yeah. That's the way we used to go.
But you never did go too far then?

No, I went as much as a hundred and some odd miles. We were Hattiesburg as far as we went. And this way would be Biloxi, Mississippi. And what I went as far as Morse Point, Mississippi, I went to Morse Point kind of regular, that was a good piece.
Did you play, what kind of places did you used to play in then? Halls. Halls. Most of them were there. Everything was Halls.

Everything was Halls. Everything was Halls. Halls was a big hotel. He'd get big hotel. I played at the Hardenburg Hotel more than one time with Eisen Morgan. That was a fine hotel. It was a big dance crowd. Yeah. Where is that? Hallsburg, Mississippi on Mobile Street. Was it all different, white and colored places? Which one? On Mobile?
All over, I mean where you're traveling. He played white and colored. Yeah, it was all different places.
Yeah. They all knew him.
Yeah. Never played in Meridian?
No, no, I've been in the town of New York. Yeah.
Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. We got to Laura. Laura, 30 miles from Hattiesburg. We got there, but I never got to Meridian and I never went to Meridian. Yeah, I know they had a big place, Wiedemann's up there, a restaurant. No, I never played. Most of them have good food there and all that. You would go out on the weekend and you would play like Friday, Saturday and Sunday? Friday and Friday, Saturday and Sunday we'd be gone. Sometimes we'd be kept over on a Monday. You would play one night in each place?
As one nighters or would you play? Sometimes two nights. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Mm-hm.
Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
In other words you didn't make enough money with the band, you needed another job too.
